title: Probability after a fixed run segment
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine and $C,C'$ configurations on the same fixed input. Suppose every choice word of length $S$ takes $C$ to $C'$. For any $T\in\mathbb{N}$ and decidable configuration property $Q$, the probability that $Q$ holds after a uniformly chosen length-$(S+T)$ run from $C$ equals the probability that it holds after a uniformly chosen length-$T$ run from $C'$.
hypotheses_covered: Every choice word of length $S$ takes $C$ to $C'$
